page_structure.title: Tactical Navigation Bar
page_structure.description: Glassmorphism header fixed at top (z-50) with logo shield, preset fast-jump links (Live Scanner, Dark Pattern Radar, History Records, Awareness Quiz, Contact Audit), backend health ping status, and 'Scan Now' primary action button.

page_structure.title: Interactive Hero & Live Scanner Command Center
page_structure.description: Combines high-impact headline, live URL input with 1-click Indian preset websites (Amazon India, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho), Screenshot OCR upload simulation, and instant Regex rule-based detection engine.

page_structure.title: Real-Time Scan Results & Risk Meter
page_structure.description: Displays live score gauge (Low/Medium/High risk), risk percentage (0-100%), circular severity progress, category breakdown (Fake Urgency, Scarcity, Hidden Costs, Confirm Shaming, Forced Action, Misleading Discounts), matched regex snippets, and PDF export trigger.

page_structure.title: Audit Records Management (CRUD Flow)
page_structure.description: Connects to FastAPI + MongoDB (/api/scans) allowing users to view recent audit records, search/filter by severity (High/Med/Low), inspect forensic details, and delete obsolete scans.

page_structure.title: Interactive Consumer Awareness Quiz
page_structure.description: Multi-question interactive challenge based on MCA project requirements. Immediate feedback, score calculation, awareness tier (Beginner, Moderate, Expert), and certificate badge generation.

page_structure.title: Interactive Incident Report & Contact Form
page_structure.description: Full-fledged interactive contact/report form connected to FastAPI backend (/api/contacts). Users report deceptive e-commerce URLs, submit screenshots, describe checkout traps, and receive immediate tracking confirmation.

page_structure.title: Futuristic Cybersecurity Footer
page_structure.description: Subtle dark slate footer with legal disclosures, MCA Project academic credits, Indian e-commerce consumer guidelines citation, and system status indicator.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow dark cybersecurity palette: Slate-950 base (#0F172A), Slate-900 cards, Cyan (#06B6D4) and Neon Blue (#3B82F6) interactive accents.
Do NOT make the header transparent; use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl and solid bg-slate-950/85 to preserve readability across scroll.

Deliver all 10 project requirements from the PDF prompt: URL Scanner, Screenshot Upload OCR simulator, Regex Pattern Engine (6 categories), Severity Risk Meter, Results Dashboard with charts, PDF Report generator/exporter, Scan History stored in MongoDB, Awareness Quiz with scoring, Indian Presets (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho), and Cross-Platform Responsive layout.
Implement interactive Contact & Deceptive Incident Reporting form wired to FastAPI + MongoDB (/api/contacts).
Ensure CRUD operations for Scan records: View history, filter by severity, inspect pattern breakdown, and delete record.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for robust test automation.

forbidden_anti_patterns: DO NOT use generic light theme or corporate gray slop; use the rich dark cybersecurity aesthetic specified in the MCA brief.
DO NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>; use custom styled UI elements.
DO NOT center-align the main container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly banned).
DO NOT use universal transition 'transition: all' which glitches transforms.
DO NOT leave header background transparent when elements scroll beneath it.
mandatory_standards: All buttons, inputs, links, and cards must contain kebab-case data-testid attributes.
All scans and contact inquiries must persist in MongoDB via FastAPI endpoints.
Use Sonner for user-facing toasts on scan completion, history deletion, PDF generation, and contact form submissions.
Ensure full mobile responsiveness down to 360px viewport without horizontal scrolling.
